steps:
1. Navigate to /procurement/invoices
2. Click 'New Invoice'
3. Step 1 - PO & GR Selection:
   - Select Invoice Type: GOODS
   - Select PO (dropdown of received POs)
   - Select GRN (dropdown of GRs for selected PO)
   - Vendor auto-populated
4. Click 'Next'
5. Step 2 - Invoice Details:
   - Enter Invoice Number (from vendor)
   - Set Invoice Date
   - Set Due Date (auto-calculated based on payment terms)
   - Currency (from PO)
6. Click 'Next'
7. Step 3 - Line Items & Three-Way Matching:
   - Items auto-populated from GRN
   - For each item:
     * PO Quantity shown
     * GRN Quantity shown
     * PO Unit Price shown
     * Enter Invoice Quantity
     * Enter Invoice Unit Price
     * System calculates Invoice Total
   - System performs automatic matching:
     * Quantity Variance = Invoice Qty - GRN Qty
     * Price Variance = Invoice Price - PO Price
     * Total Variance = Invoice Total - (GRN Qty × PO Price)
     * Variance Percentage calculated
     * Matching Status determined:
       - MATCHED: variances within tolerance
       - QUANTITY_VARIANCE: qty mismatch
       - PRICE_VARIANCE: price mismatch
       - BOTH_VARIANCE: both mismatches
   - Overall matching result shown:
     * MATCHED: Green - can auto-approve
     * DISCREPANCY: Red - requires review
8. Click 'Next'
9. Step 4 - Totals & Taxes:
   - Subtotal auto-calculated
   - Enter Tax Rate (%)
   - Tax Amount auto-calculated
   - Enter Discount Amount (if any)
   - Total Amount auto-calculated
   - Enter Payment Terms
   - Add Description/Notes
10. Review three-way match results
11. Click 'Submit'
expected:
1. Invoice created with unique Invoice Number
2. Three-way match performed automatically
3. If MATCHED:
   - Invoice status: VERIFIED
   - threeWayMatched: true
   - Ready for payment approval
4. If DISCREPANCY:
   - Invoice status: PENDING
   - threeWayMatched: false
   - Discrepancies documented
   - Requires procurement review
   - Must resolve discrepancies:
     * Contact vendor for credit note
     * Adjust quantities
     * Approve exception
5. Match result includes:
   - PO amount vs Invoice amount
   - GRN amount vs Invoice amount
   - Variance details per item
   - Overall match percentage
6. Invoice linked to PO and GRN
7. Matching comments recorded

steps:
1. Create Stock Item PR (/procurement/requisitions/new)
   - Select Item Type: STOCK
   - Add items from catalog
   - Enter quantities and specs
   - Submit for approval
2. Approve PR (/approvals)
   - Level 1: Department Manager approves
   - Level 2: Budget Controller approves
   - Status: APPROVED
3. Create RFQ (/procurement/rfq/new)
   - Link to PR
   - Select 3 vendors
   - Set closing date
   - Publish and send invitations
4. Vendors Submit Responses (external link)
   - 3 vendors submit quotes
5. Evaluate RFQ (/procurement/rfq/[id])
   - Score each response
   - Award to best vendor
6. Create PO (/procurement/purchase-orders/new)
   - Auto-populated from RFQ
   - Enter delivery details
   - Submit PO
7. Send PO to Vendor
   - Email sent with PO
8. Vendor Acknowledges PO (external link)
   - Status: ACKNOWLEDGED
9. Create GRN (/procurement/receipts/new)
   - Receive goods at warehouse
   - Inspect and accept
   - Update inventory
10. Create Invoice (/procurement/invoices/new)
    - Link to PO and GRN
    - Three-way match performed
    - Status: VERIFIED
11. Approve Invoice
    - Finance approves
    - Status: APPROVED
12. Process Payment (/procurement/payments)
    - Create payment record
    - Execute payment
expected:
1. Complete P2P cycle executed successfully
2. All statuses updated correctly:
   - PR: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED
   - RFQ: DRAFT → PUBLISHED → EVALUATED → AWARDED
   - PO: DRAFT → APPROVED → SENT → ACKNOWLEDGED → COMPLETED
   - GRN: Created with accepted quantities
   - Invoice: PENDING → VERIFIED → APPROVED → PAID
   - Payment: COMPLETED
3. All documents linked correctly:
   - PR → RFQ → PO → GRN → Invoice → Payment
4. Budget tracked at each stage
5. Inventory updated at GRN
6. Vendor performance recorded
7. Approval history maintained
8. Notifications sent at each stage
9. Audit trail complete
10. Timeline reasonable:
    - PR to PO: 5-7 days
    - PO to GRN: 15-30 days
    - GRN to Payment: 30-60 days
    - Total cycle: 50-97 days
